item.title: AI Era: Unemployment and Wealth Explosion Coexist for Two Different Groups
item.description: Discover how the AI era creates parallel worlds: while a small number of people amass massive wealth from semiconductors and AI technologies, more face unemployment anxiety. This in-depth analysis uses South Korea, SK Hynix, and the widening wealth gap as real-world examples.

item.title: Thunderstruck Poor vs King Workers: How AI Distributes Wealth in South Korea
item.description: In the AI era, your income may depend more on proximity to chip production lines than personal ability. Explore South Korea's 'kingsanjik' (king workers) and 'thunderstruck poor' phenomenon, where semiconductor workers earn record bonuses while white-collar jobs shrink.

item.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro Review: My Nuclear-Powered AI Programming Assistant
item.description: Discover how DeepSeek V4 Pro transforms programming workflows as a cheap yet powerful AI assistant. This review covers automated debugging, continuous problem-solving, and why it's better than expensive alternatives like Claude for developers.
